LATE_ARRIVING_INSERTS:
INSERT INTO SEM_DEV_REU_BASE.KEY_CD_ZIVILSTAND (
    SURROGATE_KEY, NATURAL_KEY_VALUE, NATURAL_KEY_DOMAIN, NATURAL_KEY_HASH,
    CREATED_TIMESTAMP, CREATED_BY
)
SELECT
    COALESCE((SELECT MAX(SURROGATE_KEY) FROM SEM_DEV_REU_BASE.KEY_CD_ZIVILSTAND), 0)
        + DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY src.natural_key),
    src.natural_key,
    'ZEMIS',
    HASHROW(src.natural_key),
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
    'LATE_ARRIVING_JOB_106'
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT x.natural_key FROM (
        SELECT CAST(stg.ZIVILSTAND_CD AS VARCHAR(255)) AS natural_key FROM temp_cd_zivilstand_zus_stg stg WHERE stg.ZIVILSTAND_CD IS NOT NULL
    ) x
    WHERE x.natural_key NOT IN (
        SELECT k.NATURAL_KEY_VALUE FROM SEM_DEV_REU_BASE.KEY_CD_ZIVILSTAND k
        WHERE k.NATURAL_KEY_DOMAIN = 'ZEMIS'
    )
) src;
